name: Shadumbra's Head
summary: At Splintertree Post, Shadumbra's Head proves a feared predator has fallen. Bringing it to Senani Thunderheart completes a trial of the Ashenvale Hunt and helps secure the western roads toward the Zoram Strand.

sections.title: A Menace of the Western Road
sections.body: Shadumbra hunted the woods west of Splintertree Post. Horde scouts and couriers used those paths to reach the Zoram Strand. Her speed and stealth made each journey perilous, and every westward patrol kept the post's defenders wary.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, challenges Horde champions to track and fell Ashenvale's great beasts. Shadumbra's head proves the hunter has slain one of Kalimdor's deadliest native stalkers. Now travelers can use the roads with less danger.

faq.answer: Shadumbra was a savage nightsaber who prowled the forests west of Splintertree Post. She ambushed travelers bound for the coast and was counted among Ashenvale's most dangerous local beasts.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart want the head?
faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart oversees the Ashenvale Hunt at Splintertree Post. Shadumbra's head honors a difficult hunt and confirms that westward travelers no longer face this threat.

faq.q: Where does this fit into the Ashenvale Hunt?
faq.answer: Shadumbra is one of the Ashenvale Hunt's primary trials. Slaying her alongside great forest beasts such as Ursangous and Sharptalon brings final recognition and The Hunt Completed.

faq.q: Why is clearing this beast important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Scouts and runners travel west from Splintertree Post to the Horde encampment at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand. Shadumbra threatened those crossing the untamed woods on foot.
Shadumbra prowls the woodlands west of Splintertree Post. She hunts among the trees between the road and the ancient night elf ruins scattered through central and western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is Shadumbra allied with the night elves?
faq.answer: No. Shadumbra is a wild, feral nightsaber who threatens anyone crossing her territory. Night elves often tame and revere nightsabers, but Shadumbra follows predatory instinct.

angles.text: As a tauren, you honor the Earth Mother's natural order by testing your skill against an apex predator and protecting your tribal brothers on the road.
As a hunter, you test your marksmanship, patience, and woodland survival while tracking an elusive nightsaber like Shadumbra.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep the supply lines from isolated Splintertree Post open to the Zoram Strand by removing threats like Shadumbra.
